jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
CFO part time for Exciting New AI corp
0.25% – 1.0%
Role Title: Fractional CFO / Strategic Advisory Partner (Equity)
Type: Part-Time (1 hrs/week) | Remote | Equity-Only
About Nexuslayer.io: Position Type: Part-Time (1 hr/week) | Remote | Equity-Only
About Nexus AI Foundation (nexuslayer.io) Nexus AI Foundation is a Wyoming-based nonprofit organization established to advance decentralized infrastructure for autonomous artificial intelligence systems.
THE BIG IDEAEvery Technology Revolution Requires New Infrastructure:
The Internet connected people.
Cloud computing connected applications.
Blockchain connected value.
Artificial Intelligence is creating autonomous economic actors.
For the first time in history, software is evolving beyond tools into active participants in the global economy. AI agents will increasingly execute operations, coordinate workflows, negotiate transactions, purchase services, manage resources, and operate continuously.
Nexus is building the foundational infrastructure layer to power this emerging machine economy.
Leadership & Team Structure Nexus is led by a team focused on building and scaling foundational infrastructure for autonomous AI commerce:
Rick Plotnikoff – Founder & Chief Executive Officer (Corporate strategy, ecosystem development, capital formation)

Chief Technology Officer – Leading software & blockchain architecture and engineering strategy
The Role: Fractional CFO / Strategic Advisor We are seeking a senior finance leader or experienced CFO to partner with our executive team in a lightweight, high-impact capacity as we approach our upcoming fundraise.
Commitment: 1 hour per week (Fully remote & flexible schedule)
Core Responsibility: Participating in select strategic investor calls, validating high-level financial models, and providing institutional financial credibility.
Compensation: Equity / Token Allocation Grant (0.25% – 1.%, subject to standard vesting/milestone terms).
Requirements 5+ years in tech corporate finance, Web3/crypto metrics, VC fundraising, or advisory.
Deep understanding of early-stage cap tables, valuation models, and investor communications.
Ability to join 1–2 key investor calls per month to represent our financial strategy.

jobs.title: Director, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
jobs.description:
Director, Governance Risk Compliance

Client:
Money Lending Services
Location:
Hybrid (Downtown, Toronto) 2-3x/week
Employment Type:
Permanent, Full-Time
Compensation:
$175,000 - CA$190,000 Base

Overview:

Our client, a leader in the industry, is seeking a dedicated Director of Governance, Risk, and Compliance to join their team. In this role, you will lead efforts to develop and implement comprehensive governance and compliance strategies, ensuring the organization meets regulatory standards and industry best practices.

What you will achieve in this role:

Full Program Ownership: Y
ou will directly own and operate the clients Enterprise Cyber Risk Framework and maintain active risk registers spanning cybersecurity, technology, data, and third-party vendors.

High Visibility with Leadership:
You will be responsible for translating complex risks into executive-level reporting, heatmaps, and KRI dashboards for the CISO and guide business decisions.

Hands-On Building & Modernization:
This isn't a passive governance job or a big-bank paper-pushing role. You’ll be hands-on—maturing policies, optimizing GRC workflows, validating control effectiveness, and coordinating audit readiness across NIST, ISO 27001, and financial regulatory requirements.

Enabling Commercial Speed:
You’ll partner closely with Legal, Privacy, and IT to streamline vendor risk assessments and customer due diligence, ensuring compliance supports rapid business growth without adding unnecessary red tape.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, IT controls, or related disciplines
5+ years of direct Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) experience
3+ years of leadership experience within cybersecurity, technology risk, or compliance functions
Experience working within regulated industries such as financial services, banking, fintech, insurance, payments, or wealth management

Demonstrated experience managing:

Cyber risk assessments
Risk registers
Governance documentation
Regulatory compliance initiatives
Executive reporting and remediation tracking
Strong understanding of enterprise cyber risk management practices and governance frameworks
Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, and control validation activities
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Strong understanding of:

Enterprise risk management frameworks
Information security governance
Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Data protection and privacy controls
Cloud security frameworks
Vulnerability management
Incident response governance
Third-party risk management
Business continuity and operational resilience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience within a Canadian financial institution, fintech, or other highly regulated environmen t

Professional certifications such as : CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, Or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

Experience implementing or enhancing GRC platforms and workflow automation solutions
Familiarity with: PCI DSS, SOC 2, Cloud security control frameworks, Privacy compliance frameworks

Experience mapping controls across multiple compliance and regulatory frameworks

Interviews:

2 Rounds

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

AI Disclosure:
Artificial Intelligence may be used as part of our application review process to assist in reviewing, screening and assessment of applicants. All applications are also reviewed by our recruitment team.

Additional Information:
Background screening is required as part of the onboarding process. The type of screening required (criminal, credit, or other verifications) will vary based on the position and client requirements.

Robertson & Company values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the hiring process.

Show less

Seniority level

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Financial Services
